lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to build a numeric model that changes over time, and an agent-based model where many clones follow simple rules.
A model keeps the important parts of reality and ignores the rest.
Scientists use models to predict weather, diseases and populations.
Many models update in time steps: each “year”, the population changes by a rule.
Add a capacity: if pop > 500, set pop to 500.
Better models add more realistic rules.
Instead of one number, simulate many individuals (agents) — each a clone following simple rules.
Interesting patterns emerge from the crowd.
The same model in Python: a loop for the years, a rule for growth and a rule for the limit.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
